cooling_off_until.description: Until when your account cools off after its recovery (SEC-35): approving, releasing payments, changing bank details, roles or sign-ins, break-glass and confirming others' recoveries wait until then. Absent when it does not.

features.description: The organisation's feature switches today (FR-ORG-06); absent when you are a member of none.

organisation_id.description: The organisation your session is in; absent when you are a member of none.

provider.description: The sign-in provider of a browser session (FR-ADM-08); absent for a local dev token.

roles.description: Your roles in that organisation (PRD-001 §7.1); they are read on every request, so a change applies at once.

items.description: A role of PRD-001 §7.1, such as owner, accountant or bookkeeper.

step_up_method.description: How your session last passed a second factor: at sign-in (your authenticator app), with a passkey, or by recovering your account (SEC-35); absent when it passed none, which leaves it only reading itself, stepping up and recovering (SEC-01, rev 0.43).

stepped_up_until.description: Until when your last step-up (a second factor at sign-in, or a passkey) counts for the actions that need one; absent when it does not.

super_admin.description: Whether you are a Super admin of this installation (FR-ADM-07).

user_id.description: Your Fyniq user; absent until you have one (a new installation before setup, or before you accept an invitation).
